# Theme Deduplication & Auto-Cleanup Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Eliminate duplicate/similar growing themes generated by AI and automate silent cleanup of orphaned AI-generated themes during weekly summary regenerations.

**Architecture:** Use a dual-layered approach where the LLM is supplied with existing themes as context to enforce semantic reuse (preventing name drift), while SQLite database-level cascading deletions and a clean-up transaction clear out old AI summary associations and automatically sweep away any orphaned AI-generated themes with zero associations.

**Tech Stack:** TypeScript, SQLite (better-sqlite3), Electron IPC, Vitest

---

## File Structure & Touchpoints
- **`src/main/db/schema.ts`**: Update themes metadata and type constraints.
- **`src/main/db/index.ts`**: Update SQLite schema and migrate database columns.
- **`src/main/services/themesService.ts`**: Update theme services with new creation typings and a silent cleanup function.
- **`test/main/services/themesService.test.ts`**: (New File) Unit test suite for new themes table features and cleanup routines.
- **`src/main/ipc/weeklyHandlers.ts`**: Modify summary/curator generation routines to pass candidate lists to AI and run transactioned deduplication / auto-cleanup.

```typescript
export const createThemesTable = (database: Database.Database): void => {
  database.exec(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS themes (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      external_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      color TEXT,
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
      created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
      updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
      ai_generated INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    );

    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_themes_status
    ON themes(status);

    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_themes_updated_at
    ON themes(updated_at DESC);
  `)
}
```

    database.exec('ALTER TABLE themes ADD COLUMN ai_generated INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;')

### Task 4: Create Unit Test Suite for themesService

**Files:**
- Create: `test/main/services/themesService.test.ts`

- [ ] **Step 1: Write a Vitest unit test file for themesService**
  Implement test logic covering themes creation (manual vs. AI generated), adding theme item links, and testing that `cleanupOrphanedAiThemes` only removes orphaned AI-generated themes while keeping manual/tag-imported/used AI themes intact.

```typescript
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import type { ThemeRow, ThemeItemRow } from '@/db/schema'
import { createThemesService, type DatabaseConnection } from '@/services/themesService'

let sqlite: MemoryThemesDatabase

class MemoryThemesDatabase implements DatabaseConnection {
  themeRows: ThemeRow[] = []
  itemRows: ThemeItemRow[] = []

  prepare = (sql: string): any => {
    const normalized = sql.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ')

    if (normalized.startsWith('INSERT INTO themes')) {
      return {
        run: (...values: any[]) => {
          this.themeRows.push({
            id: this.themeRows.length + 1,
            external_id: values[0],
            name: values[1],
            description: values[2],
            color: values[3],
            status: values[4],
            created_at: values[5],
            updated_at: values[6],
            ai_generated: values[7] ?? 0
          })
          return { lastInsertRowid: this.themeRows.length }
        }
      }
    }

    if (normalized.startsWith('SELECT * FROM themes WHERE external_id = ?')) {
      return {
        get: (...values: any[]) => this.themeRows.find(t => t.external_id === values[0])
      }
    }

    if (normalized.startsWith('INSERT INTO theme_items')) {
      return {
        run: (...values: any[]) => {
          const themeId = values[1]
          const sourceType = values[2]
          const sourceId = values[3]
          const exists = this.itemRows.find(i => i.theme_external_id === themeId && i.source_type === sourceType && i.source_id === sourceId)
          if (!exists) {
            this.itemRows.push({
              id: this.itemRows.length + 1,
              external_id: values[0],
              theme_external_id: themeId,
              source_type: sourceType,
              source_id: sourceId,
              relevance_note: values[4] ?? '',
              ai_extracted: values[5] ?? 0,
              created_at: values[6]
            })
          }
          return { lastInsertRowid: this.itemRows.length }
        }
      }
    }

    if (normalized.startsWith('SELECT * FROM theme_items WHERE theme_external_id = ? AND source_type = ? AND source_id = ?')) {
      return {
        get: (...values: any[]) => this.itemRows.find(i => i.theme_external_id === values[0] && i.source_type === values[1] && i.source_id === values[2])
      }
    }

    if (normalized.includes('DELETE FROM themes WHERE ai_generated = 1')) {
      return {
        run: () => {
          const priorCount = this.themeRows.length
          this.themeRows = this.themeRows.filter(theme => {
            const isAi = theme.ai_generated === 1
            const hasItems = this.itemRows.some(item => item.theme_external_id === theme.external_id)
            return !(isAi && !hasItems)
          })
          return { changes: priorCount - this.themeRows.length }
        }
      }
    }

    throw new Error(`Unhandled Mock SQL: ${sql}`)
  }
}

beforeEach(() => {
  sqlite = new MemoryThemesDatabase()
})

describe('themesService', () => {
  it('supports creating AI generated themes and auto-cleaning orphans', () => {
    const service = createThemesService(sqlite)

    // 1. Create a manual theme (aiGenerated = 0)
    const manualTheme = service.create({
      name: '理财计划',
      description: '手动规划理财记录',
      aiGenerated: 0
    })
    expect(manualTheme.aiGenerated).toBe(0)

    // 2. Create an AI-generated theme (aiGenerated = 1)
    const aiTheme = service.create({
      name: '技能提升',
      description: 'AI自动提取',
      aiGenerated: 1
    })
    expect(aiTheme.aiGenerated).toBe(1)

    // 3. Create another AI-generated theme that will have an item associated
    const aiThemeWithItems = service.create({
      name: '健康习惯',
      description: 'AI自动提取',
      aiGenerated: 1
    })

    // Associate an item with aiThemeWithItems
    service.addItem({
      themeExternalId: aiThemeWithItems.externalId,
      sourceType: 'weekly_summary',
      sourceId: '100',
      aiExtracted: 1
    })

    // 4. Verify initial mock setup counts
    expect(sqlite.themeRows.length).toBe(3)
    expect(sqlite.itemRows.length).toBe(1)

    // 5. Trigger silent cleanup of orphaned themes
    service.cleanupOrphanedAiThemes()

    // 6. Check results:
    // - '技能提升' (AI, 0 items) -> should be deleted
    // - '健康习惯' (AI, 1 item) -> should be kept
    // - '理财计划' (manual, 0 items) -> should be kept
    expect(sqlite.themeRows.some(t => t.name === '技能提升')).toBe(false)
    expect(sqlite.themeRows.some(t => t.name === '健康习惯')).toBe(true)
    expect(sqlite.themeRows.some(t => t.name === '理财计划')).toBe(true)
    expect(sqlite.themeRows.length).toBe(2)
  })
})
```

  In `src/main/ipc/weeklyHandlers.ts` around line 101, modify `extractThemesWithAI`:
```typescript
const extractThemesWithAI = async (
  provider: ModelProvider,
  model: string,
  summaryContent: string,
  existingThemes: ThemeItem[],
): Promise<ThemeExtractionItem[]> => {
  const existingThemesStr = existingThemes.length > 0
    ? existingThemes.map((t) => `- ${t.name}`).join('\n')
    : '（目前无已有主题）';

  const systemPrompt = `你是一位专注于个人成长的主题策展助手。你的任务是从周度总结中识别可长期追踪的主题。
你的首要准则是【语义重用与对齐】。系统里已存在以下主题候选池：
${existingThemesStr}

输出要求：
1. 提取 2-5 个主题。如果总结内容不足，输出空数组 []。
2. 每个提取的主题，你必须优先并尽可能在上面的【已有主题候选池】中寻找最契合的一项进行映射对齐复用（即使语义高度吻合而字面上有些微差异，也必须强制选用候选词，不可私自创造表达相似的新词）。
3. 只有当周总结中的行为或关键成长轨迹，确实与所有【已有主题】没有任何语义交集时，才允许定义和返回一个全新的主题名称（3-8个汉字，简洁精准，如「职业转型」「亲密关系」「健康管理」）。
4. 仅输出一个 JSON 数组，每个元素包含三个字段，不要包含任何其他文本或 Markdown 标记：
   - "name": 主题名（已有主题名或全新的具有长期叙事意义的名称）
   - "confidence": 置信度 0-100 的整数
   - "evidence": 从总结原文中引用一句最能支撑该主题的话（30字以内）

正确输出示例：
[{"name":"技能提升","confidence":85,"evidence":"本周完成了Rust基础教程的三章内容"},{"name":"健康管理","confidence":70,"evidence":"连续四天在23:30前入睡"}]`;
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Refactor `saveExtractedThemes` to clear previous summary associations and run orphan cleanups**
  In `src/main/ipc/weeklyHandlers.ts` around line 170, modify `saveExtractedThemes`:

```typescript
const saveExtractedThemes = (
  themesService: ReturnType<typeof createThemesService>,
  extracted: ThemeExtractionItem[],
  summaryId: number,
): number => {
  // 1. 在写入新关联之前，首先清理本总结之前历史关联的所有 AI 主题关联。
  try {
    const database = getDatabase();
    database.prepare(
      'DELETE FROM theme_items WHERE source_type = ? AND source_id = ? AND ai_extracted = 1'
    ).run('weekly_summary', String(summaryId));
    console.log(`[主题提取] 已成功解绑周总结(ID: ${summaryId})之前的旧 AI 主题关联`);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`[主题提取] 清理旧主题关联失败:`, err);
  }

  if (!extracted.length) {
    // 若本周无有效提取，也应在解绑后触发一次孤立主题自清理并直接返回
    themesService.cleanupOrphanedAiThemes();
    return 0;
  }

  console.log(`[主题提取] 准备写入 ${extracted.length} 个新提取主题: ${extracted.map((t) => t.name).join(', ')}`);

  let count = 0;

  for (const theme of extracted) {
    if (!theme.name?.trim()) continue;

    // 模糊匹配已有主题（双向包含匹配）
    const allThemes = themesService.list();
    const matched = allThemes.find(
      (t) => t.name.includes(theme.name.trim()) || theme.name.trim().includes(t.name)
    );

    let themeExternalId: string;
    if (matched) {
      themeExternalId = matched.externalId;
      // 更新已有主题时间 + 追加新 evidence 到描述
      themesService.update(themeExternalId, {
        description: matched.description
          ? `${matched.description}; ${theme.evidence?.slice(0, 100) ?? ''}`
          : (theme.evidence?.slice(0, 200) ?? ''),
      });
    } else {
      // 标记 aiGenerated: 1 以支持无关联时自动蒸发
      const created = themesService.create({
        name: theme.name.trim(),
        description: theme.evidence?.slice(0, 200) ?? '',
        aiGenerated: 1,
      });
      themeExternalId = created.externalId;
    }

    // 关联到本周总结（ON CONFLICT 自动跳过重复）
    try {
      themesService.addItem({
        themeExternalId,
        sourceType: 'weekly_summary',
        sourceId: String(summaryId),
        relevanceNote: theme.evidence?.slice(0, 200) ?? '',
        aiExtracted: 1,
      });
      count++;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`主题关联失败 (${theme.name}):`, err);
    }
  }

  // 2. 所有新提取关联写入完成后，立即执行孤立 AI 自动生成主题的静默清理，使那些失联的旧主题彻底蒸发。
  try {
    themesService.cleanupOrphanedAiThemes();
    console.log('[主题提取] 孤立 AI 主题自蒸发静默清理完成');
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[主题提取] 静默清理孤立 AI 主题失败:', err);
  }

  console.log(`[主题提取] 成功写入 ${count}/${extracted.length} 个主题关联`);
  return count;
};
```
